mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in job growth (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market strength, boosting equity valuations and 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month's PAYEMS AND UNRATE < previous month's UNRATE
failure_condition: The interaction does not lead to statistically significant positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05) or the effect dissipates within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 11500, indicating strong demand, it triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not cross the 11500 threshold or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer demand (GDPC1) signals supply-demand balance, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > previous month AND INDPRO > previous month
failure_condition: The interaction does not result in statistically significant positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05) or the effect fades within the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher rates signal economic caution, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not rise above 5.0% or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) dropping below 4.0% triggers positive 5-day returns as markets anticipate labor market strength and growth.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.0% or 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show a sustained upward trend or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 112 triggers positive 20-day returns as it signals robust supply chain activity and investor confidence.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not cross 112.0 or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
